concerns.text: No task implements the reliability‑diagram slope calculation required by SC‑003, making the success criterion untestable.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 5 – Full result aggregation & success‑criterion checks
concerns.text: No task computes or records the PIT‑histogram Kolmogorov‑Smirnov test p‑value required by SC‑004, leaving this criterion without measurable evidence.
FR‑008 (pipeline runtime limits) is not enforced or measured by any task; there is no task that checks total runtime ≤ 6 h, isotonic ≤ 30 min, or Bayesian ≤ 60 min.
